brand.notes: Carrier AC for PK market (Carrier Global / Carrier Corporation, USA; residential range in AU/NZ & region by AHI Carrier). PK presence: Smart Climate Solutions Pvt Ltd = authorized Carrier distributor/service provider (climatesolutions.com.pk); retail = dhabione.pk 38QHA018VSP / 38QHA036VSP inverter hi-wall + OLX window/inverter listings. No official Carrier PK site (carrier.com pk paths 404; carrier.com.pk = Hall Road Lahore stabilizer brand, quarantined). Primary sources: AHI Carrier AU official fault-code library (carrierair.com.au, 24 PDFs) + Carrier 45MHHAQ owner's manual + SplitAtlas / RemoveAndReplace / HowTo HVAC / Ample Air corroboration. 5 model-scoped series — Comfort 22 hex 34, multi-split 38GVM/40GVM 56, Elite E/P 11, SHV inverter ducted 10, SHV fixed ducted 7 — same digits across lines never merged. Residential scope only: commercial chillers/VRF/AHU, Toshiba Carrier JV, Trane/Bryant/Payne, furnace/thermostat, Enterprise 40MAQ (not PK-confirmed), Alpha lamp-only tables and SEO aggregators quarantined.
